text:
incident-bot: Pager: kv-cache memory pressure > 92% on kv-pool-us-east-1 (llama-2-34b, qwen-7b-mqa). Request errors 5xx rising, tail latency spikes. Dashboard: https://rwi.redwood/dashboard/incident/1872003456

oncall_jamie: ack we're paging. looking at evicted shards + prefix-key count.

eng_sre_lee: seeing cardinality explosion on prefix keys: unique_prefixes ~ 4.2M (normal ~120k). continuous_batch_count per host up by 12x. likely prefix growth from a recent runtime change.

eng_runtime_sam: rolled adaptive_batching_v2 + prefill=true in yesterday's canary (rev: a1b2c3d). batch_window_ms increased 40->80 to reduce small-batch overhead. suspect prefill is causing long-lived KV entries for short sequences.

ml_infra_aman: if prefix cardinality is exploding, eviction policy might be no-op. Suggest hotfix: enforce prefix_eviction_policy=LRU, prefix_cache_max_keys=500k, and reduce batch_window_ms back to 40. also throttle continuous_batching to 2x.

eng_platform_tess: can apply config via runtime-config service. prepping patch.

eng_runtime_sam: commands to apply (rolling, 30s stagger):
```
# set eviction and shrink batching window
rwc runtime-config set --pool kv-pool-us-east-1 --key prefix_eviction_policy --value LRU
rwc runtime-config set --pool kv-pool-us-east-1 --key prefix_cache_max_keys --value 500000
rwc runtime-config set --pool kv-pool-us-east-1 --key batch_window_ms --value 40
rwc runtime-config rollout --pool kv-pool-us-east-1 --stagger 30s
```

deploy-bot: rollout started for kv-pool-us-east-1 by eng_platform_tess at 1872003510 :construction:

oncall_jamie: routing suggestion: temporarily divert new sessions for high-latency models to dedicated-fallback pool and disable MQA flavor for queued work. Can we change routing policy quickly?

eng_platform_tess: applied eviction policy + cache cap + batch_window rollback. memory pressure dropping from 93% -> 68% across pool within 90s. continuous_batch_count trending down.

support_maya: customer impact: three enterprise customers (cust-114, cust-223, cust-889) reported higher 5xx and slow responses between 08:12-08:23 UTC. Noting SLA windows and opened priority tickets.

product_ana: please draft short status update for customers: what happened, mitigation, ETA for full recovery.

eng_sre_lee: metrics: 5xx peaked at 6.1% (baseline 0.02%). latency p95 for affected models went from 220ms -> 3.4s. after hotfix 5xx dropped to 0.4% and p95 at 310ms. leaving monitoring in place.

eng_runtime_sam: follow-ups: revert adaptive prefill for MQA and add guardrails:
- add prefix growth alert when unique_prefixes > 500k per pool
- test adaptive prefill under synthetic GQA/MQA workload in canary
- add opt-in flag per-model for prefill
assign postmortem to @eng_runtime_sam and @eng_sre_lee

product_ana: assigned to timeline for customer comms and postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident resolved, status: mitigated. runbook: track postmortem and ensure customer comms. incident close ETA 3h.
